original_task: Offline support-only Known image training plus held-out support calibration and sequential class discovery on unseen image query stream.
model_inputs: Two224px augmented Known images with labels during training. Held-out support Known images/labels for confidence thresholds, PCA and covariance fitting. Query model/classifier visual input only; labels kept by evaluator, not passed into inspected AGE.add_old_points.
model_outputs: Fixed Known head predictions or monotonically appended discovered-category row indices; no physical track-ID input.
losses: Known CE of normalized256D head logits divided0.1 plus SupCon0.5 on two-view projected representations. ViT-B/16 backbone only last block11 trainable, 768D input→3layer256D MLP with BN/GELU→weight-normalized Known-only classifier.
training_protocol: Actual main defaults100epochs/batch128/headSGD0.005/backboneSGD0.025/momentum0.9/weightdecay5e-5. Every5epochs extraction/evaluation/checkpoint saves. Cosine schedulers step only inside this every5epoch branch, not everyepoch.
calibration: Held-out20% of selected Known labeled support, before query exposure. Perclass max-softmax mean-minus0.8sample-std mixed0.5 with global mean threshold. PCA42D fit only support-calibration features; alternate supervised reductions also support labels only.
stream_update: Frozen eval image features then arrival-order loop; outliers compare Gaussian densities of Known+discovered rows. If argmax is Known, create novel row with current feature and average covariance over existing cov_known rows; otherwise update chosen discovered mean/count and recent-window LedoitWolf covariance blended with fixed global covariance. Inliers bypass bank to Known class.
causal_or_noncausal: Structural AGE state update uses only current feature/earlier bank and frozen support statistics; wholequery feature collection is not by itself future-dependent forward. Optional separate default-on KMeans is transductive/oracle-total-K but its predictions do not feed AGE. No changed-future/ID/role mutation run.
state_memory: Known rows not query-updated; discovered numeric indices append without reset within one AGE instance. Instance recreated each full evaluation. Percluster window32 but totalcluster count unbounded; no WAIT/candidate-set classifier/quarantine/reversal/versioned splits/merges.
evaluation: All/Old/New uses global GT-Hungarian remapping including Known identities, despite direct Known prediction. Train-unlabelled GT accuracies printed every5epochs; no best-by-GT selection implemented in inspected active path, checkpoints simply overwritten then. No fixedKnown/CommitCT evaluation.
static_findings_not_executed_failures: Paper3.1 says real-time GT received, but active labels/mask used for metrics; query labels do not enter Gaussian updates. No training-supervision or runtime purity certification inferred from either statement.
Paper Eq13 promotes log-density for underflow avoidance; _pdf_batch computes log_pdf then torch.exp before argmax. Numerical underflow risk not measured.
Initial cov_matrix uses torch.from_numpy(np.cov(...)) with NumPy float64 while query/features are explicit float32; no uniform dtype cast before triangular solve. Compatibility unexecuted.

On spawn, prior is mean of all current cov_known including previously discovered covariances; not exactly fixed global covariance. Count/mean history uses all assigned samples, covariance uses window32, paper mainwindow20.
Seed argument default1 is not honored by seed_torch(0) at entry; inference reseeds0. Multi-seed/order mutation not executed.
SupCon weight0.5 is hardcoded despite --sup_con_weight; --save_best_thresh unused. Scheduling only every5epochs differs from an assumed100cosinesteps.
Known support classes absent from calibration can produce empty class_mean/PCA or dimension issues; not validated with user assets.

paper_limitations_summary: Simple outlier threshold and dependence on density/subspace quality, limited-sample covariance and ordering/window choices. Paper claims standard image benchmarks, not our video category CT; noisy-routing aggregate accuracy does not certify cross-video memory recovery.
TrackOCD_root_connection: OSR/calibrated uncertainty and density-aware anonymous memory are candidate controls for candidate ambiguity and firstbadwrite propagation, but no existing code supplies candidate-aware learned WAIT or reversible memory; dense current-observation router contract still needs atomic integration.
what_to_borrow: Support-only covariance/threshold baselines with lawful disjoint calibration, numerical log-space controls, finite uncertainty/density hypotheses and explicit order/coverage tests against frozen baselines.
what_not_to_borrow: Global Hungarian Known remapping, query-GT tuning/oracleK/transductive comparator as online result, raw-density equality as safe decision, unbounded append-only clusters as self-correcting versioned memory.
